title: The mapping parsing logic needs protection agains stack overflows

labels.name: :Search Foundations/Mapping
labels.description: Index mappings, including merging and defining field types

labels.name: Team:Search Foundations
labels.description: Meta label for the Search Foundations team in Elasticsearch

body:
There has been a report of a node shutting down because of the following StackOverflowError when parsing mappings:

```

java.lang.StackOverflowError: null
```

While this specific mapping was corrupt, Elasticsearch should also have better protection against stack overflow errors.
